entries.title: Security update
changes: All messages are encrypted end-to-end — chats protected in transit and at rest
HMAC-SHA256 unlock keys; vault password verified server-side only
Sessions and unlock keys stored in macOS Keychain
Per-account chat isolation — sign in or out resets local state cleanly
API rate limits, tier gating, and restricted CORS on the edge
Privacy mode skips cloud API and sync entirely

entries.title: Final
changes: Toggle web search off in Settings or from the composer Search chip
Dynamic usage meters — context and allowance progress bars update live
Web search off badge, placeholder, and header update when search is disabled
`/search …` still forces a one-off Mozilla lookup when search is off
Lab matches macOS: Search toggle and centered progress bars in the composer

entries.title: Rescue path actually fires after search
changes: After web search, rescue uses the fast nano model in short slices instead of one hung attempt
Model budget shrinks when search used part of the platform time limit

entries.title: Fix empty/hung free-model replies
changes: Handle reasoning models that return empty content by retrying with a larger token budget
Fail fast per attempt (8s cap) so rescue models can answer instead of hanging Offline
Prefer the faster nano model on High effort

entries.title: Slim rescue for search-heavy answers
changes: If the main model times out after web search, a slim rescue call answers without the search blob
Tighter search snippets so grounded questions stop starving the model

entries.title: Harder fix for model reachability
changes: Reserved rescue model attempt so busy free models can’t burn the whole request
write_file tools only when coding / file requests (not every chat turn)
StickerCoder+/ChopCode skip web search unless you use /search

entries.title: Fix model timeouts / sticky Offline
changes: Model deadline no longer includes web-search time — stops “couldn't reach its model” on normal questions
Coding tiers fall back to another model when the primary is busy; short rescue completion as last resort
macOS Offline badge only sticks when the host is actually offline (not on transient errors)

entries.title: StickerCoder+
changes: New StickerCoder+ effort — coding specialist mode in Lab and the macOS app
Pick StickerCoder+ alongside ChopCode for agentic coding and file creation

entries.title: Tool-call files · labeled sidebar · more settings
changes: Agent can create files via write_file tool-calls (Lab + macOS); replies include downloadable file cards
macOS nav rail shows text labels (toggle in Settings → General)
More settings: Tools (write_file, confirm save, default folder), Agents (file tools), Beta (file previews)

entries.title: Expandable sidebar · 500 MB uploads
changes: macOS Agents Window: animated expand/collapse for the secondary sidebar (rail toggle)
Attachment limit set to 500 MB per batch (Lab + macOS)

entries.title: File & image attachments
changes: Attach files and images in Lab and the macOS app when signed in
Uploads go to private Supabase Storage (resumable for large files); text previews reach the model, large binaries by link

entries.title: ChopCode mode
changes: New ChopCode effort — coding specialist mode in Lab and the macOS app
SEO keywords for cs.AI / ChopCode on HQ homepage and product page

entries.title: Mozilla Search in the macOS app
changes: New Search rail in the Agents Window — same Mozilla engine as the website (MDN, Wikipedia, DuckDuckGo)
Results open in your browser; no API key required

entries.title: Mozilla engine, profile plans, What’s New
changes: Branding: chopsticksAI is now cs.AI 2.0
Mozilla search engine on /chopsticks-ai/#search (MDN, Wikipedia, DuckDuckGo) — same path the AI uses first
Account plans read from Supabase profiles (token_budget / context_limit / plan_label) — no hard-coded emails
Usage soft warning at 80% allowance + live cooldown countdown
macOS app shows What’s New from changelog.json after an update

entries.title: Accounts, Usage, and Cursor-style Agents
changes: Cursor-style Agents Window UI (Agents, Automations, Repos, Marketplace, Usage, Account, Settings)
Optional Supabase accounts — sign in to sync chats across Lab and the macOS app
Usage tab with Fathom Pro oi-pl credit upgrades (not OpenRouter keys)
Credit tiers: 2 keys → 800k / 64k context; 5 → 900k / 96k; 10 → 1m / 128k
Homepage scavenger mint cooldown: 10 minutes
Auto-update crash fix (NSAlert on main thread) and safer install staging

entries.title: Cloud chat sync
changes: Account rail and email/password auth via Supabase
Chats saved to private RLS-backed tables when signed in

entries.title: Usage upgrades
changes: Usage tab and Fathom Pro API key redemption for higher allowances

entries.title: Stability
changes: Fixed launch crash when checking for updates

entries.title: Safer auto-update
changes: Install updates only under ~/Applications
Staging path fix so updates cannot delete the app mid-install
